# CombatDen

> CombatDen is a member retention app for combat sports gyms — Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (BJJ), MMA, Muay Thai, boxing, and kickboxing. It runs alongside the gym's existing management software (no card migration required) and stops members from quitting through engagement, rank tracking, and a built-in loyalty program.

## What it does

- **Member app (iOS & Android)** branded with the gym's logo, colors, and name.
- **Engagement engine**: booking a class triggers content matched to the member's level. Beginners show up less nervous and stay longer.
- **Loyalty program**: members earn points per class attended and redeem them for gym-configured rewards (branded shirts, guest passes, discounted private training). Drives attendance, brings in friends, generates word-of-mouth.
- **Class management**: schedule, attendance, rank tracking, class streaks.
- **Works with your current software**: no payment-info migration required. Imports member names, emails, ranks, and class schedule.

## Why it matters

- It costs roughly 5× more to acquire a new combat-sports gym member than to retain one.
- Keeping just 5% more members in a 100-member gym is worth tens of thousands of dollars per year.
- A retained member is worth $150+/month. A $20 branded T-shirt that keeps them one extra month is 7× ROI before factoring in word-of-mouth.

## Audience

Combat sports gym owners and managers — BJJ, MMA, Muay Thai, boxing, kickboxing — who currently use software like Mindbody, Kicksite, Spark Membership, ZenPlanner, Gymdesk, or similar, and want to improve member retention without switching their core gym management system.
